recommendation: DO NOT roll out the flat per-delivery bonus as tested. It genuinely improves marketplace liquidity — fulfillment +1.87 pp (robust: cluster, randomization-inference p=0.000, wild-cluster bootstrap all agree), ETA p90 -6.1 min, no-courier rate -0.36 pp, concentrated in the supply-short and balanced zones, with only a small (~17%, not significant) neighbour-zone drag. BUT at ~R$ 281 per incremental delivered order against a R$ 10 contribution margin it destroys value: the bonus is paid on every delivery while only ~2% of them are incremental. Re-run ONLY with the bonus restructured to reward incremental supply (a threshold / surge-triggered payment, not a flat per-delivery bonus), capped to the supply-short + balanced zones, with the neighbour-zone spillover guardrail and a hard budget live.
